legacy_migration.trigger: LOCKED-SCRIPT-GATED: an original multi-person scene requires several authorized entrances, departures and alignment changes to alter who visually carries the scene while broad geography should remain available
legacy_migration.directing_decision: HYPOTHESIS: use one project-original moving shared master that reweights attention through body routes, foreground crossings and depth changes; do not copy this source's people, costumes, rooms, coffin-like objects, staircase, compositions or events
legacy_migration.coverage: Project-original geography reveal → shared medium/wide reframe → foreground-crossing attention transfer → stable group tableau → renewed route; add closer units only for locked-script information that cannot remain legible in the master
legacy_migration.blocking: Define three project-original zones and one safe carrier route; schedule one entrance/exit or height-state change at a time while inactive figures retain simple readable marks
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Hold while each group state becomes visually readable; advance the camera only on an authorized blocking change; the source's 912.375s selected hold describes one clip and is not a target duration
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK: source audio was not auditioned; dialogue, overlap, silence, ambience, score and sound-led movement are UNKNOWN and must come only from the locked script/project audio plan
legacy_migration.applicability: Original locked scripts where ensemble spatial reconfiguration itself carries changing attention and actors/virtual agents can safely maintain a shared geography
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Exact private reactions, rapid comedy timing, safety-sensitive crowds, or a script-authorized reveal that must be withheld from other characters cannot remain in a broad shared field
legacy_migration.failure_mode: The moving field becomes shapeless, background faces invent reactions, entrances collide, the central beat loses priority, or AI identity/furniture drift destroys geography
legacy_migration.counterexample: HYPOTHETICAL / NOT SOURCE-OBSERVED: under the same ensemble-reweighting trigger, a fixed master plus selective reaction close-ups may preserve hierarchy better when one information-changing response must be privileged; same-trigger contrary source remains pending
legacy_migration.unknown: Source dialogue, objectives, relationships, conflict cause, reaction causality, sound, exact camera rig/lens, hidden joins, authorial intent and whether every observed reframe was necessary
legacy_migration.ai_risk: camera=HIGH for long multi-zone path and continuous reframing; performance=HIGH for many synchronized entrances/gestures; continuity=HIGH for identities, wardrobe, furniture, anchor and route state
